author: War Inc Wiki Team
excerpt: Hunting mode is the best source of Forge Stones in War Inc: Rising. This guide covers the tank-stacking strategy, the best single-target damage dealers, optimal formations for each boss type, and how to maximize your daily rewards.

sections.heading: Hunting Mode Overview
sections.content:
Hunting mode pits your formation against powerful boss monsters. Each boss has unique attack patterns and weaknesses. The mode resets daily with new boss rotations.

You get 3 free Hunting battles per day. Extra battles cost gems and are almost never worth it. Make your 3 daily runs count by optimizing your formation for single-target damage.

Hunting is one of the best sources of Forge Stones in the game — which makes it one of the most important daily activities. Forge Stones are the primary bottleneck for pushing hero merge levels past 6. A consistent Hunting routine is a great long-term investment.

sections.heading: The Tank-Stacking Strategy
sections.content:
The core strategy for Hunting is tank-stacking. Stack all your tanks on one side of the formation to shift enemy aggro in one direction. This concentrates the boss's damage on your most durable units while your damage dealers attack from safety.

The preferred setup is stacking tanks on the right side. Place your highest HP and best defensive units there. Radiant Warrior is the best tank for this role — his shield and massive HP pool make him ideal for absorbing boss damage.

Behind your tanks, place your single-target damage dealers. They should be protected from the boss's AoE attacks while outputting maximum damage. Place support units like Oracles and healers behind the damage dealers.

This formation gives your damage dealers maximum uptime because the boss is focused on the tank stack and not attacking your backline.

sections.heading: Best Heroes for Hunting
sections.content:
Hunting mode favors single-target damage dealers over AoE specialists. Here are the top performers.

Flame Mages are S-tier for Hunting. Their consistent single-target damage output is unmatched. Level 8 Flame Mages are especially effective.

Royal Archers are also S-tier. They provide excellent single-target damage and are available in the Exchange Shop, making them easier to acquire than most mythics. Buy all 10 Royal Archers from the Exchange Shop each rotation.

Forest Scouts at level 9 are A-tier. Their 2.5 tile range when leveled makes them effective backline snipers against bosses. Place them in the back row for survival.

Bombs are A-tier. Their death damage contributes significant burst against bosses.

Oracles are essential support. Their attack buff stacking (4% per Oracle, up to 20 layers) dramatically increases your damage dealers' output.

Frontline Tanks: Radiant Warrior is best. Goddess of War shields the tanks and keeps them alive longer.

sections.heading: Hunting Formation and Positioning
sections.content:
Build your Hunting formation around these principles.

Place all tanks on one side (right side is the meta). This concentrates aggro and lets your damage dealers attack without interruption.

Place your single-target damage dealers in the back on the opposite side from your tanks. This gives them maximum distance from the boss.

Place Oracles and buffers in the middle. A level 7 Oracle covers extensive area.

Use Goddess of War to shield your tank stack. Her shield keeps your frontline alive through the boss's heavy attacks.

Scouts at level 9 should be placed in the back row for survival. Their 2.5 tile radius gives them excellent range.

Test different formations using the Trial feature. Different bosses may require slight adjustments to your positioning.

sections.heading: Hunting Rewards and Daily Strategy
sections.content:
Always complete your 3 daily Hunting runs. Even if you cannot clear the highest difficulty, lower-tier rewards still provide value.

Forge Stones are the primary reward from Hunting. They drop regularly and are the main reason to do Hunting every day. Gold and hero shards are secondary rewards.

Higher difficulty levels yield better rewards. If you can consistently clear difficulty 3 but not 4, run difficulty 3. The gap in rewards between difficulty levels is not large enough to justify failing runs.

Building a dedicated Hunting team is one of the best long-term investments in the game. Once your Hunting team can consistently clear the highest difficulty, your forge stone income becomes much more reliable.

The 3 free daily runs are enough for most players. Extra runs cost gems and are only worth it if you are pushing for top leaderboard positions or need forge stones urgently.

sections.heading: Hunting-Specific Tier List
sections.content:
S Tier: Flame Mages, Royal Archers (single-target damage dealers).
A Tier: Forest Scouts, Bombs, Oracles.
B Tier: Buffers and tanks.

This is a very different tier list from general PvP. AoE specialists like Frost Queen are much weaker in Hunting because they spread their damage across multiple targets. Build a separate Hunting team if your main team relies heavily on AoE.

The best Hunting team composition is 2-3 tanks (stacked on one side), 3-4 single-target damage dealers, 2 Oracles, and 1 Goddess of War for shielding.

mainEntity.name: What is the best strategy for Hunting mode in War Inc: Rising?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stack all tanks on one side (preferably the right) to shift boss aggro, then place single-target damage dealers like Flame Mages and Royal Archers on the opposite side.

mainEntity.name: What are the best heroes for Hunting mode?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flame Mages and Royal Archers are S-tier for Hunting. Forest Scouts and Bombs are A-tier. Oracles provide essential attack buff support.

mainEntity.name: How many Hunting runs should I do daily?

acceptedAnswer.text: Always complete your 3 free daily runs. Extra runs cost gems and are rarely worth it unless you need forge stones urgently.

mainEntity.name: Are Flame Mages better than Frost Queen for Hunting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Flame Mages deal concentrated single-target damage which is better for Hunting. Frost Queen's AoE is wasted on single bosses.
